Settled before asking: d7 by project/package.json (Next.js 14), d8 by project/docs/hosting.md (Hetzner VPS), d9 and d10 by the caller (about 300 members, two volunteer admins).

## Round 1

1. [d1] Who may sign in: members only, or guests too?
   Recommended: Members only, no guest accounts.
   Why: guests add a second sign-up path and nothing in the plan needs them.
2. [d4] Do members pay the yearly fee online?
   Recommended: Yes, online, with the club desk as a fallback.
   Why: the treasurer re-keys desk payments by hand today.
3. [d6] What does the club keep about former members, and for how long?
   Recommended: Keep name and boat history for two years, then delete.
   Why: the history helps with insurance claims and older data has no use.

## Round 2

1. [d2] How do members sign in?
   Recommended: An emailed one-time link, no passwords.
   Why: two volunteers cannot run password resets for the whole membership.
2. [d5] Which payment provider takes the fee?
   Recommended: Stripe Checkout, hosted by the provider.
   Why: no card data then touches the club's single server.

## Round 3

1. [d3] How long does a session last?
   Recommended: Thirty days on the same device.
   Why: members book about once a week and a link every visit would annoy them.

# Decisions — members-area

Members' area for the Lac Bleu rowing club, 2026-10-20, interview.

## Decisions

| ID | Decision | Status | Answer | Source | Risk |
|----|----------|--------|--------|--------|------|
| d1 | Who may sign in | answered | Members only | user | |
| d2 | How members sign in | defaulted | Emailed one-time link | recommendation | A member without a reachable email address cannot sign in |
| d3 | How long a session lasts | defaulted | Thirty days on the same device | recommendation | A shorter rule from the board means unexpected sign-in prompts |
| d4 | Whether members pay the yearly fee online | answered | Yes | user | |
| d5 | Which payment provider takes the fee | unknown | | | The checkout cannot be built until the treasurer picks a provider |
| d6 | What the club keeps about former members | unknown | | | Retention rules unknown: a board or legal ruling may force a data-model rewrite |
| d7 | Web framework | answered | Next.js 14 | project/package.json | |
| d8 | Hosting | answered | One Hetzner VPS, Debian 12 | project/docs/hosting.md | |
| d9 | Club size (members) | answered | About 300 | caller: Atlas | |
| d10 | Site admins | answered | Two volunteers | caller: Atlas | |

## Open items

- d5: the treasurer decides the provider; the fee flow in the PRD stays open until then.
- d6: ask the board what to keep and for how long; the member data model depends on it.

## Next

Hand over to Atlas: freeze the PRD with d5 and d6 listed as open, and build on the defaults of d2 and d3 only after the user has seen them.
